papers.title: Expert-Level Crisis Detection in Mental Health Conversations
CRADLE Bench: A Clinician-Annotated Benchmark for Multi-Faceted Mental Health Crisis and Safety Risk Detection

source_claims.quote: We develop and evaluate a lightweight model specialized in crisis detection in multi-turn dialogue, fine-tuned from Qwen3-32B.

description.text:
A Qwen3-32B model fine-tuned for turn-level mental health crisis detection in multi-turn conversations. This is the best-performing checkpoint (epoch 2) from 3-epoch training, as reported in the CRADLE-Dialogue paper.

Full fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3-32B, trained on the CRADLE-Dialogue synthetic training corpus — 3,058 dialogues (48,557 turns) generated from Reddit posts via GPT-5 and annotated with structured Alert–Confirm labels.

output_type.quote: Given a multi-turn dialogue and the model's own previous predictions, the model assigns a crisis label to the current user turn only.

use_claim.quote: A Qwen3-32B model fine-tuned for turn-level mental health crisis detection in multi-turn conversations.

warning.quote: This model is intended for research purposes in clinical NLP and crisis detection. It is not a substitute for professional mental health assessment or crisis intervention.

serving.system_prompt: You are a clinical dialogue safety annotator. Return EXACTLY ONE LINE: the label(s) or 'none'. No commentary, no reasoning, no markdown.
serving.notes: tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; the template is chat_template.jinja. The card example sets do_sample False and max_new_tokens 64, which differ from generation_config.json. config.json max_position_embeddings is 40960. The card's training max sequence length is 4096. tokenizer model_max_length is 131072. trainer_state.json records epoch 2.0, global_step 3208, max_steps 4812, num_train_epochs 3, train_batch_size 1. The card says precision bfloat16 and does not mention quantization. Hub safetensors total is 32762123264. The system prompt is the card example; the jinja template does not hard-code it.

evaluation_reported.text: Turn-Level Micro F1 51.31. Turn-Level Macro F1 54.96. Turn-Level Micro Recall 54.99. Dialogue-Level Micro F1 68.88. Dialogue-Level Macro F1 69.29. Dialogue-Level (Confirm Only) Micro F1 76.03. Evaluated on the CRADLE-Dialogue test set (600 clinician-annotated dialogues).
